dish.note: Ham and gruyère toastie under bubbling cheese sauce. Moi insists on a knife and fork.
dish.how: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and cook until thick. Stir in half the gruyère, the mustard and nutmeg. Make four sandwiches of bread, ham and a little sauce, then spread the rest of the sauce on top, scatter with the rest of the gruyère and grill at 220°C until bubbling and browned. Serve with a green salad.
dish.make_ahead: Make the cheese sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; build and grill to serve

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick.
Stir in half the gruyère, the mustard and nutmeg.
Make four sandwiches of bread, ham and a little sauce, top with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Grill at 220°C until bubbling and browned.

veg.make_ahead: Make the cheese sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick, then stir in half the gruyère, the mustard and nutmeg.
Make four sandwiches of bread, mushrooms and a little sauce, top with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Grill at 220°C until bubbling and browned.

dish.vegNote: Mushroom and gruyère toastie under bubbling cheese sauce.
